verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for an LLM tracing and observability service that stores traces, inputs and outputs. The evidence pack covers tracing, evaluations, scorers, cost tracking, OTel ingest, the MCP server and a REST Service API. None of it documents retention policies, TTLs or deletion of traces and data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
